FLUIDLOVEBAND-SETLIST.title: Setlist
FLUIDLOVEBAND-SETLIST.description:
Every card you play adds its role as a note. When 3 notes are in, the band plays a Song:
[gold]Solo[/gold]: 3 the same. The big one.
[gold]Full Band[/gold]: one of each. Gain 1 [gold]Groove[/gold], deal 4 damage to ALL, gain 4 [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Jam[/gold]: 2 + 1. Half a Solo of the doubled role.
FLUIDLOVEBAND-GROOVE.title: Groove
FLUIDLOVEBAND-GROOVE.description: Each stack makes your Songs deal 2 more damage and grant 2 more [gold]Block[/gold]. Lasts all combat.
